rationale: The agent did not follow policy or fulfill the user’s request. Issues: (1) No authentication of the user was shown before acting. (2) The agent changed the order without first confirming the change. (3) The change performed was incorrect—the user wanted size 8, but the agent updated to size 9. (4) The user said they want the material but didn’t specify which; the agent assumed leather without clarification. (5) The agent stated a refund would be issued to PayPal without tool-backed confirmation or evidence. These violations and the incorrect outcome mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
